title: Session handoff: glyph-cli onto its post-stop successor (DEC-290 fleet stop)
description: Fleet-stop handoff for the glyph-cli worker; the implementation notes are the content.
implementationNotes:
Fleet-stop handoff (DEC-290, carrier ODOC-640), glyph-cli worker, model claude-sonnet-5-5, native teammate of the opum-agent leader, 2026-11-19. Supersedes GCLI-43 as the restore point; GCLI-43 is still accurate for everything before 2026-11-17 and for the mechanics paragraph, which is not repeated here.

STATE AT WRITE: origin/dev a7aa2b0110ebda81a39d621fc7f8940f6491c94b before this handoff PR; origin/main 63577d4318f30f9c34ecd392b5db874482ad0bf7, untouched, nothing promoted and no promotion while the stop holds. Tree clean. Open PRs: none besides this handoff PR. Nothing In Progress other than this task until it closes.

LANDED SINCE GCLI-43: opum-ai/glyph-cli#89 (squash 0c464f331632906d5431d615fd5f013f235ca3fb): opum-doc's ruling on GCLI-12 and GCLI-36. GCLI-36 completed with ACs 1-4 checked against #78, #80, #84, #86. GCLI-12: AC3 re-scoped to the DEC-216 (a4)(b)/(a10) behaviour (time-budget omission, never hangs), AC6 re-scoped per opum-doc option A (the fallback-when-Glyph-unavailable test belongs to opum-cli and moves to OCLI-340); AC1-AC4 and AC6 checked. #90 (squash ec15ad45a79adf97d2e7db3d3ff60a9e7ddb403f): GCLI-34, ADR 0002 dated amendment on the EXIT_CODES wording, round-2 review approved at 00db3f7; #91 (squash a7aa2b0110ebda81a39d621fc7f8940f6491c94b) closed GCLI-34. The 2026-11-18 grooming read found 11 ready items, none stale (answered to the leader); a harness consultation (DEC-289) was answered to opum-harness.

HOLDS: GCLI-12 stays open, label hold: AC5 (the opum-cli side) waits on opum-ai/opum-cli OCLI-340. When OCLI-340 lands, tick AC5 against it and complete GCLI-12; never close it with AC5 unchecked. GCLI-18 stays held (readBlobs must fail indeterminate on a missing or ambiguous object) until the leader sends a brief.

OPEN PRS: none apart from this handoff PR. REVIEW WORKTREES: 34 review-* directories under .claude/worktrees/, including review-90-561e7ce (561e7ceac15f18b31e940ead59e7aa0cabba3085) and review-90-00db3f7 (00db3f74687997cbae948a59e7f32988c68cc331); none may be removed, deregistered or pruned (DEC-208).

STILL TO DO, none admitted: GCLI-39, GCLI-35, GCLI-33, GCLI-26 to GCLI-31 (see GCLI-43), plus the carried N6, N7 and P3 items for test/codemap-budget.test.ts.

NEXT STEP AFTER THE RESTART: nothing without a brief. Restore by ref (fetch, origin/dev and origin/main SHAs, clean tree, no open PRs, nothing In Progress), report to team-lead, and wait. Do not set CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE.

MECHANICS NEW SINCE GCLI-43: run git push bare, never piped or chained; a chained git checkout -b plus git commit is refused while still on dev, so branch in its own call; gh pr merge --delete-branch also removes the local branch, so the later git branch -D reports not found; foreground sleep is blocked and macOS has no timeout, use gh pr checks --watch and gh run watch.
finalSummary: Fleet-stop handoff written at write; the implementation notes carry the state.
